description.en: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

description.fr: Aucune description.
description.en: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
